SELECT
  industry,
  ROUND(AVG(salary), 0) AS avg_salary,
  COUNT(*) AS job_postings
FROM job_postings
WHERE salary IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY industry
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC
LIMIT 5;</textarea>
